english.title: Cause serious disruption by tunnelling
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, created or participated in the creation of a tunnel at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), the creation or existence of which caused, or was capable of causing, serious disruption to

(A)_[two or more individuals,]_
(B)_[an organisation, namely **(..SPECIFY ORGANISATION..)]_

in a place other than a dwelling, intending that creation or existence to have that consequence of serious disruption or being reckless as to whether it would have such a consequence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1) and (4) of the Public Order Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) It is a defence for a person charged with this offence to prove that they had a reasonable excuse for creating, or participating in the creation of, the tunnel (section 3(2)).
(ii) Without prejudice to the generality of the defence above, a person is to be treated as having a reasonable excuse for the purposes of that subsection if the creation of the tunnel was authorised by a person with an interest in land which entitled them to authorise its creation (section 3(3)).

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Achosi aflonyddwch sylweddol trwy greu twnnel
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), heb esgus rhesymol, bu ichi greu neu gyfrannu tuag at greu twnnel yn **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), a bu i gread neu fodolaeth y twnnel achosi, neu fe allai achosi, aflonyddwch sylweddol i

(A)_[ddau unigolyn neu ragor,]_
(B)_[sefydliad, sef **(..SPECIFY ORGANISATION..)]_

mewn lleoliad heb fod yn annedd, gan fwriadu i greadigaeth neu fodolaeth y twnnel achosi aflonyddwch sylweddol neu fod yn fyrbwyll ynghylch a fyddai’n cael canlyniad o’r fath
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 3(1) a (4) Deddf Trefn Gyhoeddus 2023.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 3 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
